Here's how to prompt this easily: "spawn a session in project XYZ to do ABC". The GitHub Copilot app will find project XYZ and spawn a session that will communicate with the current one! No manual back and forth, the sessions coordinate themselves automatically 🔥🔥🔥

value.text: If you haven't yet tried /orchestrate in the GitHub Copilot app you are seriously missing out. You can create plans that control sessions *across different projects* that coordinate with each other. I've used this to develop a nuget package producer and consumer at the same time!
